title: ServiceNow Jumps 25% in 3 Months: Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
author: Na
description: ServiceNow's AI business surpassed $1B in ACV in Q2 2026 with 40%+ sequential growth, and subscription revenues rose 24.5% to $3.88B. However, intensifying competition from Microsoft, Oracle, and Salesforce in enterprise AI and workflow automation, combined with margin pressure from acquisitions and a premium valuation (8X forward P/S), has led to a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating.

Earnings estimates have declined, and the Zacks Rank is #4 (Sell).

title: Adobe Before Q3 Earnings: Should You Hold or Fold the ADBE Stock?
author: Na
description: Adobe is set to report Q3 FY2026 results on September 10 with expected revenues of $6.67-$6.72 billion and non-GAAP EPS of $6.05-$6.10. The company's AI initiatives including Firefly, Acrobat AI Assistant, and GenStudio are driving growth with AI-first ARR exceeding $500 million. However, intensifying GenAI competition, rising investments, and near-term ARR pressure from freemium strategy expansion present concerns. Adobe shares have underperformed the sector by 23.8% year-to-date but trade at a valuation discount.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Adobe demonstrates strong AI monetization momentum with Firefly ARR approaching $300 million and AI-first ARR exceeding $500 million, plus robust enterprise adoption. However, this is offset by intensifying GenAI competition, rising investments pressuring profitability, and near-term ARR headwinds from aggressive freemium expansion. The stock's 23.8% YTD underperformance and Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating reflect these offsetting factors.

title: UiPath Slides 24% After Q2 Earnings: Is PATH Stock a Buy?
author: Na
description: UiPath shares dropped 24% following Q2 fiscal 2027 results that beat revenue expectations and included raised full-year guidance. Despite strong fundamentals including 12.5% ARR growth, fourth consecutive GAAP profitability, and AI appearing in 18 of 20 largest deals, investors focused on modest Q3 guidance and restrained ARR increases. Analysts view the selloff as creating an attractive entry point for patient investors, rating the stock a Buy.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Despite the 24% stock decline, the company delivered strong fundamentals: Q2 revenues beat consensus by 3.1%, achieved fourth consecutive GAAP profitability, raised full-year guidance, maintained 109% net dollar retention, and AI featured in 18 of 20 largest deals. The selloff is viewed as an overreaction creating a buying opportunity.

title: Salesforce Stock Gains 34% in a Month: Time to Hold or Book Profits?
author: Na
description: Salesforce shares surged 34% in one month following strong Q2 FY2027 results showing stabilized double-digit revenue growth of 10.8% YoY and accelerating cRPO growth of 14%. Agentforce ARR exceeded $1.5 billion with 240% YoY growth, positioning the company as an AI and enterprise data platform beyond traditional CRM. Despite the sharp rally, the stock trades at a reasonable 16.30x forward P/E, below sector averages and major competitors, suggesting room for upside. However, risks include potential pressure on per-user subscription models from AI agents and slower enterprise IT spending amid economic uncertainty.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong Q2 results with stabilized double-digit revenue growth (10.8% YoY), accelerating cRPO growth (14% YoY), and exceptional Agentforce ARR growth (240% YoY). Valuation remains attractive at 16.30x forward P/E below sector average. Management guidance raised for FY2027 with signs of potential revenue reacceleration in H2.

title: Why Monday.com Stock Popped in August
author: Eric Volkman
description: Monday.com stock rose 16% in August despite initial sell-off following its Q2 earnings beat. The stock recovered late in the month after Salesforce's strong earnings report boosted investor sentiment toward legacy software and CRM companies. The author views Monday.com as undervalued with a forward P/E under 14.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Company delivered a double beat on Q2 earnings with 22% YoY revenue growth and 13% adjusted net income growth. Stock rose 16% in August and author considers it undervalued with attractive forward P/E ratio under 14 and high-margin business model.
